evidence_level: Invented behavioral personas for agent-driven usability simulation; not validated psychometric assessments or representative clinician research.

personas.name: Dr. Morgan Ellis
personas.context: Between visits; scans headings and buttons before paragraphs; comfortable with routine EHR forms and email.
needs: Clear saved, pending and completed states
Confidence that reviewing did not send or sign anything

personas.name: Casey Rowan, FNP

behavior.risk_tolerance: moderate when review and undo are clear

personas.context: Frequently interrupted; uses ordinary clinical forms, messaging and a tablet; prefers concrete checklists and is reluctant to ask IT.
needs: Named owner and next action for unfinished work

protocol.interaction: Each agent uses its own fresh browser tab and visible UI only. No source inspection, developer tools, shell/API shortcuts or coaching toward expected controls.
protocol.thinking_aloud: Record expectation before a meaningful action and interpretation afterward. Stop after two plausible failed choices per goal and record help needed.
tasks: Identify available, connected and attention-needed services
Find the next setup action and responsible person
Save a jotted note, leave and return
Find Chief's handoffs and distinguish draft completion from unfinished human work
measurements: Severity and suggested wording or navigation change
protocol.timing: Automation latency and model deliberation are not human dwell time. Do not invent human time-on-task, SUS scores or population estimates.
protocol.scope: Synthetic data only. No real recording, sign-in, account permissions, messages, clinical signatures or external actions. These agents are usability testers, not clinical authorities.
